analysis:
Examined all six primary analyses and the available source replay; the replay contains 4 of 37 reviewed units, with 33 omitted. No independently supported regression is established by the supplied evidence, but this does not clear the unreplayed runtime changes.
ServingReadiness.swift:31–74 adds advisory traffic verdicts: disconnects, missing status after 90 seconds, explicit denial and expired App Attest leases produce blocked diagnostics. Lines 54–64 infer eligibility from hardware trust without an authorization object or from a legacy path. TB-002/TB-011 require additional live routing gates, so integration must confirm these labels accurately describe the coordinator contract and that snapshots cannot survive connection replacement. The predicate and snapshot lifecycle are not replayed; neither a bypass nor accurate live eligibility is established. Fixed recovery advice and connection timing documentation introduce no demonstrated credential, prompt or receipt disclosure.
Across the supplied analyses, ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift:82 invokes supervision, ProviderLoop+Serve.swift:293,419,429 records connection transitions, ProviderLoop.swift:787–796 adds recovery bookkeeping, and DaemonState+Coding.swift:18,51,89 serializes optional connection state. The changelog at lines 4–5 describes idle-only re-registration with exponential backoff. Tests describe corresponding expectations, not production enforcement.
Material unresolved review: inspect ProviderLoop+ServingAuthorizationRecovery, UnauthorizedConnectionRecovery, connection-state reset/persistence and changed CLI callers. Verify active-work/drain/update exclusion, bounded retries without backoff resets, old-grant/challenge invalidation and rejection of late replies. Re-registration must preserve revocation, qualification and the frozen endpoint-resumption ceiling (A-016, T-052–T-054, T-057); diagnostic state must not become authority or overstate trust (T-058). Missing implementations and replay prevent reconciling those questions. No supplied evidence establishes changes to encryption, cache isolation, billing or fan authority.
